hebrewText: וַ/יִּשְׂכְּר֣וּ לָ/הֶ֡ם שְׁנַיִם֩ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְ/אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ מַעֲכָה֙ וְ/אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י מֵידְבָ֑א וּ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן נֶאֶסְפוּ֙ מֵ/עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה

tokens.bdb: to hire
tokens.kjv: earn wages, hire (out self), reward, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: two; also (as ordinal) twofold
tokens.kjv: both, couple, double, second, twain, [phrase] twelfth, [phrase] twelve, [phrase] twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

tokens.bdb: thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth
tokens.kjv: thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).

tokens.bdb: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
tokens.kjv: thousand.

tokens.bdb: a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone
tokens.kjv: chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.

tokens.bdb: Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman
tokens.kjv: Maachah, Maachathites. See also H1038 (בֵּית מַעֲכָה).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)
tokens.kjv: abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

tokens.kjv: Medeba.

tokens.bdb: Ammon, a son of Lot; also his posterity and their country
tokens.kjv: Ammon, Ammonites.

tokens.bdb: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
tokens.kjv: assemble, bring, consume, destroy, felch, gather (in, together, up again), [idiom] generally, get (him), lose, put all together, receive, recover (another from leprosy), (be) rereward, [idiom] surely, take (away, into, up), [idiom] utterly, withdraw.
